checks: The convex hull has the prescribed exposed endpoint fibers, and any middle combination of the two endpoints uses equal weights. Their Minkowski average is D⊂T, even when the expanded endpoint leaves T. Therefore the middle fiber and lattice census are exact.
The endpoint volume scales by (1±t)⁴ and the centered covariance numerator by (1±t)⁶. Both sums are even; M′(0)=0 and each fixed-normal covariance width has zero derivative.

The signed support-speed integrals cancel between opposite endpoints for both mass and each centered quadratic. The chosen common capture orientation gives θ_J times ∫∂D h_D−c, which is 4vθ_J by the divergence theorem.

Strict endpoint margins persist at nearby marks and times, so the entire endpoint term has derivative −4v on high caps and zero on low caps. At positive width the two kink levels in the fixed middle fiber are null, giving the mark derivative −S_j u_j. Width changes by o(t) and its local ramp response is bounded.

Positive spanning gives a selected cap with positive threshold increase for each nonzero displacement. Its positive own strip coarea makes a small increase strictly reduce its mass; monotonicity then handles arbitrary displacements in the compact middle fiber. The finite envelope cancels the mark term with the balanced response weights.

Exposed endpoints stay below the old central maximum since v<Q. Dividing by M(t)=M(0)+o(t) gives the exact coefficient. In the certified small-parameter regime Carathéodory and the five-cone exclusion give one positive-weight cap per cone; independence of any four makes the spanning full, and retargeting preserves the exact responses.

The linked revision changes only the statement. It specifies the regular four-simplex, Dδ and δ domain, the positive probability weights, and exact zero vector balance. Spanning plus a relation with all positive coefficients puts zero in the interior of the response convex hull: any supporting functional through zero would be nonnegative on all vectors, and balance with positive coefficients would force it to vanish on their full span. This supplies precisely the envelope hypothesis, with the unchanged proof and parents.
